# wafertools

Free, open-source (MIT) tools for semiconductor wafer test data. Two projects, built on the
same code. Choose by the user's goal:

- To LOOK AT wafer map data, with no code: tsmap. A desktop and browser application that
  opens STDF, ATDF, CSV, JSON and Parquet and draws wafer maps, findings, charts, lot
  galleries and reports. Runs in the browser with nothing to install, and files are read on
  the user's machine, never uploaded. https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/app/
- To put wafer maps INSIDE an application being built: wafermap. A JavaScript/TypeScript
  library (`@wafertools/wafermap` on npm) that renders interactive wafer maps from die test
  data, with yield and spatial statistics. No runtime dependencies, no server.

## Common questions
- [How to draw a wafer map from an STDF file](https://wafertools.github.io/draw-wafer-map-from-stdf/) - open it in tsmap, what a map from STDF is made of, what to check before trusting it, and script-based alternatives.
- [How to draw a wafer map in JavaScript](https://wafertools.github.io/wafer-maps-in-javascript/) - a working example with wafermap, and how to use your own data.

## tsmap
- Machine-readable map: https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/llms.txt
- [Documentation](https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/), [Learn tsmap](https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/learn/) (thirteen short lessons), [glossary](https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/learn/glossary/), [troubleshooting](https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/troubleshooting/)
- [Downloads](https://github.com/wafertools/tsmap/releases/latest) for Linux, macOS and Windows
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wafertools/tsmap)

## wafermap
- Machine-readable map: https://wafertools.github.io/wafermap/llms.txt
- [Quick start](https://wafertools.github.io/wafermap/quickstart/), [Developer Guide](https://wafertools.github.io/wafermap/guide/), [API reference](https://wafertools.github.io/wafermap/api/), [27 runnable examples](https://wafertools.github.io/wafermap/examples/)
- [Rules for AI coding agents](https://wafertools.github.io/wafermap/agents/): the traps that produce silently wrong maps. Read before writing wafer map code.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wafertools/wafermap), [GitHub](https://github.com/wafertools/wafermap)

## Parser
- `@wafertools/testdata-parser`: the Rust STDF/ATDF/CSV parser both projects use (WebAssembly in the browser, native on desktop), available as a standalone package. https://wafertools.github.io/tsmap/parser-api/

## Other
- [What's New](https://wafertools.github.io/whats-new/) - curated changes across both projects.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/wafertools/.github/discussions) - questions, ideas and file-format requests.
